scope: U06 navigation areas and shared dialog focus; local only

implementation.focus: initial focus, Tab/Shift+Tab containment, topmost Escape, composing/default-prevented keys respected, origin focus and background inert restoration
implementation.navigation: six allowlisted area hashes; primary nav grouped, communication includes mail/reminders, projects/catalog in Service
implementation.drafts: Same-tab close/reopen retains library context, editor, creation forms/photos and family form. No localStorage/sessionStorage or draft URL persistence. beforeunload covers creation fields and OCR files as well as existing dirty editors/photo tasks.
implementation.return: Native scroll remains on close; family search return is inline to avoid feedback overlay collision

verification.node_navigation_behavior: passed; stacking, focus/Tab, nested Escape, refused close, composing key, prior inert restoration
verification.static_bindings: all literal static getElementById bindings have elements
verification.pilot: Email dialog at 1440 and 390 px passed before expansion
verification.additional_family_email_return: Three final 320/390/1440 px checks passed after adding the two-line family email return hook; broad browser evidence precedes only this additive hook
verification.browser: Headless Edge, three synthetic viewport scenarios; every request intercepted, no real private data or live actions
verification.full_gate: not rerun for bounded frontend change; prior U04 1677-test run remains historical

issues_found_and_fixed: Missing moved reminders button caught by browser; now inside Communication with static binding regression check
Legacy test expected library drafts to be cleared on close; updated to preservation contract
Floating family return was covered by shared feedback; moved inline at document search and retested with feedback visible
limitations: Physical Safari Mac/iPhone and VoiceOver acceptance pending
Drafts live in the current tab only; confirmed reload, closing browser or OS termination can lose them; beforeunload support is browser dependent
Hashes restore the main area, not an exact selected article, nested dialog or draft; invalid hashes ignored
Library reopening deliberately preserves loaded state; category/search actions refresh data under existing discard guard
No push/deployment; unrelated untracked directory preserved
